statement: A check by host code (`AuthorizationChecker`, in every form: the public one, and the control plane's in another app and as a recorded principal) is answered for a request in progress however long it runs, on the memberships and attributes it began with, also once its token has expired; once the adapter that bound the request has ended it, every check of it is an implicit deny (`Deny(null)`). The WebFlux and gateway adapters end a request when the chain's `Mono` terminates (after a streamed body's last element is written, on an error, or when the client goes away), before they pass its completion or error on, so a subscriber that sees the chain complete sees the request ended; the servlet filter when the dispatch returns, or, for an async request, when it completes, fails or times out. On the servlet containers the ERROR dispatch, which the filter does not take, finds the context and every check of it denied. A transport of the application's own that calls `Pipeline.evaluate` ends a request by closing its `Outcome` (`AutoCloseable`; nothing for a refused request; idempotent, and one end with an adapter's in either order); one that never closes it leaves the request in progress, and the test kit ends its contexts with `PipelineFixture.end` and `PermittedRequest.end`.
guards: runtime:AuthorizationCheckerTest#a check of a request its adapter ended is denied in every form
runtime:OutcomeCloseTest#closing the outcome ends the request it permitted
runtime:OutcomeCloseTest#an adapter's end and a close are one end, in either order
testkit:RequestEndTest#a fixture context ended is denied
testkit:RequestEndTest#a permitted request ended is denied
webflux:RequestEndTest#a check while a streamed body is written is answered, and one after it is denied
webflux:RequestEndTest#a check after the client went away is denied
spring-boot:ServletRequestEndTest#a suspend handler checks after it resumed, and the context is denied once the response is written
spring-boot:ServletRequestEndTest#an async result completed before the handler returned is answered on the ASYNC dispatch, then denied
spring-boot:ServletRequestEndTest#the error page finds the context and a check of it is denied
